privacy.docSubtitle: Policy on the collection and processing of personal data of LLC "HOOPLA BRIDGE" HOOPLA
privacy.section1Para1: This policy on the collection and processing of personal data (hereinafter referred to as the Policy) is drawn up in accordance with the requirements of the Law of the Republic of Uzbekistan "On Personal Data" dated July 2, 2019 No. ZRU-547 and defines the procedure for collecting and processing personal data and measures to protect personal data.
privacy.section1Para2: This Policy applies to personal data that the Operator may obtain from Users through the Service, the "HOOPLA" Application, and the Landing Page, as well as during interactions with Users, including phone calls.
privacy.section1Para3: This Policy is a publicly available document and is subject to placement in the "HOOPLA" Application.
privacy.section2Para1: Operator – LLC "HOOPLA BRIDGE", which independently organizes and (or) carries out the collection and processing of personal data within the "HOOPLA" Application, as well as determines the purposes of personal data processing, the list of data to be collected and processed, and the operations performed.
privacy.section2Para2: User – an individual who has reached the age of majority and uses the "HOOPLA" Application to receive services provided by partner coffee shops.
privacy.section2Para3: Partner – a legal entity or an individual entrepreneur registered in accordance with the legislation of the Republic of Uzbekistan, providing services to Users as part of cooperation with "HOOPLA".
privacy.section2Para4: Personal data – information related to a specific User that allows their identification.
privacy.section3Title: Collection and Processing of Personal Data
privacy.section3Para1: Personal data is collected when the User registers in the "HOOPLA" Application or subscribes to a membership plan.
privacy.section3Para2Intro: The Operator has the right to process the following personal data:
privacy.section3Para2Item1: Last name, first name, middle name;
privacy.section3Para2Item4: Data on the use of the "HOOPLA" Application.
privacy.section3Para3Intro: Personal data is collected and used for:
privacy.section3Para3Item1: Providing Users with services available in the "HOOPLA" Application;
privacy.section3Para3Item2: Improving service quality and analyzing user experience;
privacy.section4Para1: The Operator takes all necessary measures to protect personal data from unauthorized access and leakage.
privacy.section4Para2: The transfer of personal data to third parties is possible only within the framework of the agreement between the User and the Operator or when there are legal grounds.
privacy.section5Para1: The Operator reserves the right to amend this Policy in accordance with changes in legislation or the development of the "HOOPLA" service.
privacy.section5Para2: The new version of the Policy comes into force from the moment of its publication in the "HOOPLA" Application.
privacy.section5Para3: The User may send a request regarding their personal data to the Operator's email address.

terms.intro1: On providing access to the subscription
terms.intro2: Limited Liability Company "HOOPLA BRIDGE", hereinafter referred to as the "Company," represented by the Director acting under the Charter, offers to enter into this Public Offer for the provision of access to the subscription (hereinafter referred to as the Offer, Agreement, or Contract) under the terms set forth below:
terms.definitionSubscription: the User's right to receive a specified number of cups of coffee at the Company’s partner establishments during the billing period, obtained through the mobile application "HOOPLA".
terms.definitionSubscriptionActivation: the action taken by the User to gain actual access to the subscription after purchasing it.
terms.definitionSubscriptionCancellation: the termination of the subscription due to the User’s violation of the terms of the Offer.
terms.definitionPartner: an individual entrepreneur or legal entity registered in the Republic of Uzbekistan, providing coffee services at partner coffee shops participating in the "HOOPLA" program.
terms.definitionUser: an individual of legal age who has subscribed through the "HOOPLA" application to receive coffee at Partner establishments.
terms.definitionMobileApp: the digital platform "HOOPLA", available on iOS and Android, which allows users to purchase and manage subscriptions.
terms.section1Para1: This document constitutes a public offer. In accordance with Article 367 of the Civil Code of the Republic of Uzbekistan, a public offer is an invitation to enter into a contract under the stated terms with any person who expresses consent.
terms.section1Para2: Actions indicating acceptance of the Offer (subscribing, using the "HOOPLA" application) constitute acceptance of the Offer.
terms.section1Para3: The Company reserves the right to amend this Offer without prior notice to Users. The updated version takes effect from the moment it is published in the "HOOPLA" mobile application.
terms.section2Title: RIGHTS AND OBLIGATIONS OF THE PARTIES
terms.section2CompanyItem1: Provide Users with access to the subscription through the "HOOPLA" application;
terms.section2CompanyItem2: Publish up-to-date information about Partners, their service conditions, and working hours;
terms.section2CompanyItem3: Ensure technical support for the application.
terms.section2UserItem1: Use the subscription within the provided limit (1 cup of coffee per day);
terms.section2UserItem2: Not transfer the subscription to third parties;
terms.section2UserItem3: Follow the service rules of Partner coffee shops.
terms.section3Para1: The subscription is issued through the "HOOPLA" application and is personal.
terms.section3Para2: The subscription price is determined by the Company and displayed in the application.
terms.section3Para3: The subscription is valid for 30 calendar days from the date of activation.
terms.section3Para4: In case of violation of usage rules by the User, the Company has the right to cancel the subscription without a refund.
terms.section4Para1: The Company is not responsible for the quality of services provided by Partners.
terms.section4Para2: In case of technical failures or temporary unavailability of the service, the Company undertakes to resolve the issue within a reasonable time.
terms.section5Para1: Disputes arising from this Offer shall be resolved through negotiations. If the dispute cannot be resolved in this manner, the parties have the right to refer the matter to the court at the location of the Company.
terms.section6Para1: The Company undertakes not to disclose Users’ personal data to third parties without their consent, except in cases provided for by the legislation of the Republic of Uzbekistan.
terms.section7Para2: The full text of the Offer is available in the "HOOPLA" application and on the official website of the Company.
